sections.title: WHAT IS ALOPECIA?
bullets: Alopecia totalis – complete hair loss on the scalp
Alopecia universalis – complete loss of all body hair
text: Alopecia is an autoimmune condition that causes hair loss.
The immune system attacks hair follicles, leading to shedding.
It affects both men and women of all ages.

list.q: Is the difference noticeable when hair falls out around the treated area?
list.a: No – pigmentation is planned to look natural even if hair loss continues.

list.q: How long does SMP effect last for alopecia?
list.a: 2–4 years. It can be refreshed with one session.

list.q: Is SMP suitable for women with diffuse alopecia?
list.a: Yes – the technique is adapted to make the effect natural with existing hair.
